menu.welcome:
👋 *Welcome to HoneyBlockChain!*

I am your AI Beekeeper Assistant. Please tap the menu below to select an option:

settings.choose_lang:
🌐 Please select your preferred language:
कृपया अपनी पसंदीदा भाषा चुनें:
settings.lang_updated: ✅ Language has been successfully updated to English!

general.coming_soon: 🚧 This feature is coming soon! Send *menu* to return.
general.cancelled: ❌ Action cancelled. Send *hi* to return to the menu.

diag.select_prompt:
🤖 *AI Hive Diagnostics*

What would you like to analyze?
diag.img_prompt:
📸 *Image Analysis*

Please send a clear photo of your beehive or honeycomb to check for visible diseases (e.g., Varroa, Foulbrood).

Send *cancel* to abort.
diag.aud_prompt:
🎤 *Audio Analysis (Queen Check)*

Please record and send a 5-10 second voice note holding your phone near the entrance of the hive.

Send *cancel* to abort.
diag.err_img: ⚠️ Please send an *image*. Send *cancel* to abort.
diag.err_aud: ⚠️ Please send an *audio voice note*. Send *cancel* to abort.
